# Obed Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old initially, passing away three years later  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c25 P28](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0028), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c37 P3](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0003), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c2 P12](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0012)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P3](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0003), [v1 c37 P5](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0005), [v1 c37 P10](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0010), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley, St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c2 P2](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c3 P30](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0030), [v1 c16 P14](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0014)</sub>

## Appearance

Obed was an unusual-appearing man with an awkward frame, hunching shoulders, and lengthy iron-gray hair. He had worn a thick, gentle brown beard continuously since the age of twenty. In his later years, his hair turned far grayer and ultimately turned silver.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c36 P26](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0026), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011)_

## Personality

Extremely bashful, quiet, and timid, Obed hated being surrounded by unfamiliar people or visiting places where he had to converse. He harbored a deep fear of women, believing they quietly mocked him, though he enjoyed loquacious companions who led the conversation without requiring his participation. Gentle and tender-hearted, he disliked conflict and took great joy in quiet, simple pleasures.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c2 P2](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0002), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P12](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0012), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c2 P74](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0074)_

## History

Obed Abernethy lived as a quiet farmer at Grey Shutters in Brierley with his sister Thirza. Facing increasing difficulty finding farm labor and dealing with a heart condition, he and Thirza arranged to adopt an orphan boy. When Obed went to the station at Alder River, he discovered that a mistake had brought an eleven-year-old girl, Nell Harcourt, instead. Unable to bring himself to turn her away, Obed brought her home and gently persuaded Thirza to keep her. Over the next three years, Obed formed a deep, affectionate bond with Nell, delighting in her chatter, supporting her school accomplishments, and occasionally buying her special gifts like a stylish Christmas dress. As his heart trouble worsened, he was advised by a doctor to avoid strenuous labor and excitement. Shortly after Nell won the Avery scholarship, Obed suffered a fatal heart attack and passed away peacefully at home.

## Background by volume

- Son of a bashful father who constructed Grey Shutters far back from the main road  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- Resided at Grey Shutters alongside his sister Thirza from adulthood  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031)</sub>
- Grew a beard at age twenty that he kept for forty years  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- Lifelong supporter of the Conservative political party  <sub>[v1 c18 P9](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0009), [v1 c25 P6](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0006)</sub>
